analysis.title: Thursday Thoughts – Power (IPPs + Broader Power)
key_insights: Talen named Terry Nutt CEO and announced a $1.5 billion accelerated share repurchase. Constellation and Amazon announced a 20-year power purchase agreement. These are the first notable group headlines in a couple of months.

The CEG/AMZN deal is a small increase to near-term FCF (low single digit % for 2027 on GIR numbers). GS sees it as a step in the right direction and a 'heartbeat' for the group going forward. CEG was +4% pre-market at time of writing.

Power stocks have been challenging YTD despite no change to medium/longer-term fundamentals and power curves moving higher recently. GS thinks specialists are generally neutral on the group and generalists lean more cautious.

PJM strength: the September peak contract was set to clear at $128, a 47% increase from where it traded entering the month. Cal27-Cal29 strips also moved higher, which reinforces demand for forward power.

GS still sees the broader setup for power infrastructure and deployment as robust. Recent interest in the behind-the-meter (BTM) theme versus IPPs does not have to be mutually exclusive, and both groups can work.

A coalition of Blackstone's QTS, NextEra, Siemens Energy, Quanta, NEI and Lancium is pushing back on Texas data center opposition. $200 bn of data center projects were blocked across the US in 1H. About 90% of new ERCOT power connection requests are from data centers, with 600+ data centers in Texas, ~80 under construction and ~173 planned.
